findings.title: Missing React key on GrafanaRuleListItem in filtered list
findings.body: The old `GrafanaRuleLoader` element had `key={key}`. The replacement `<GrafanaRuleListItem ...>` in the `rules.map` has no key, even though the artificial `key` is still computed for every rule. React will warn about missing keys. The list is appended to incrementally and each item holds local state (delete modal, silence drawer, clone redirect), so reconciliation without keys can mix up item state. `DataSourceRuleLoader` and `UnknownRuleListItem` in the same switch still pass `key`.

findings.title: Silence drawer can never open for list-view rules (promRule only)
findings.body: The list view now passes only `promRule`, so `rule` is undefined. The drawer renders only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer`. `AlertRuleMenu` shows "Silence notifications" via the new prom-based ability check, and clicking it calls `setShowSilenceDrawer(true)`. The drawer never renders, so the menu item appears but does nothing. The drawer needs a path that works from `promRule`, or the item must be hidden when there is no ruler rule.

findings.title: Delete and Pause actions silently disappear in the new list view
findings.body: `canDelete` and `canPause` are now computed from the prom-based abilities, but rendering still requires a ruler rule. Delete needs `canDelete && rulerRule`, and Pause needs `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. In the list view only `promRule` is passed, so neither item is ever shown, even for users with permission. The new test expects exactly 4 menu items and so codifies this. Delete and pause are regressions in the list menu, and the ability computation for them is dead code. This needs either an explicit decision and comment, or a delete and pause path that works from the prom rule.

findings.title: Federated rule group check dropped in the deprecated useAllAlertRuleAbilities
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities(rule: CombinedRule)` used to compute `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hardcodes `isFederated = false` with a TODO. Existing consumers that pass a CombinedRule from a federated (Mimir) group will now see update, delete and pause as supported where they were previously blocked. This is a behavior regression outside the list view that this PR targets.

findings.title: returnTo dropped from rule view link
findings.body: The removed `GrafanaRuleListItem` built the href with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo: createReturnTo() })`. The new one links to `/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view` with no `returnTo`. Navigating from the list to a rule and using the back or return affordance no longer returns the user to their filtered list. This is not mentioned as intentional.

findings.title: Stale comment and variable name after ruler prefetch removal
findings.body: The ruler prefetch was removed, but the comment still says "This is not mandatory to preload ruler rules..." and the variable is still named `cacheAndRulerPreload`. Both now describe behavior that no longer exists.
